verdict.rationale: Whisper documents a translation option: `--task translate` in the CLI (whisper-gh-5). The README and model card describe speech translation as a core task alongside multilingual ASR (whisper-docs-7, whisper-docs-8). The output language is English only, and the API docs in the pack show only a transcription endpoint. missing for 10: translation into arbitrary non-English target languages, an evidenced hosted API translation endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of translation quality.
